scenes.headline: The week closes itself
scenes.line: The week runs Sunday to Sunday. On Sunday evening it closes. The figures freeze.

scenes.headline: It writes the agenda
scenes.line: And it writes the agenda. Eleven items. Ninety minutes. A name against every one.

scenes.headline: Every unit answers
scenes.line: Twenty past, the unit round. Every unit manager answers for their own people.

scenes.headline: The week builds the meeting
scenes.line: The week builds the meeting. Everybody presents. Nobody writes a report.
